Kostadis Roussos: And uniforms belonging to the greater temple. The party's Arcana checks failed to reveal anything further. Sequoia nevertheless looked up, explaining, the answer is always on the ceiling. An investigation result of 21 vindicated him.
Kostadis Roussos: Four creatures hung overhead by their tails. Clay's claws paused. I was right, Segui said in belief. I was saying a joke. Oh my god, the creatures were nightmarish, gaunt, ape-like predators with ash gray hides, four long, muscular arms ending in hooked black claws, powerful jaws, filled with uneven fangs.
Kostadis Roussos: Three alert eyes and thick, prehensile tails wrapped around the stonework. Their limbs were unnaturally jointed for climbing, ambushing, and faint violet psychic energy pushed around their skulls.
Kostadis Roussos: Zephter acted first, but missed both pistol shots. Xenia and Sequoia concentrated their attacks on the same creature, while the predators unleashed psychic blasts against the party. Xenia, Zephyr, and Calmer resisted. Sequoia failed the DC-17 Wisdom save, suffered 17 points of damage, and was stunned. Guardians, creating a 15-fort aura that damaged and slowed several attackers.
